question: At a heating rate of 20 °C/min, what initial and burnout temperatures did the corn straw–oil sludge composite pellet fuel have?
rendered: According to page 4 of the document, at a heating rate of 20 °C/min, the corn straw-oil sludge composite pellet fuel (CF) had an initial temperature (Ti) of 294.9 ± 1.4 °C and a burnout temperature (Tb) of 557.6 ± 2.8 °C.
